add_reporting_issue.issue: Figure 1 (grey-matter increase over the first month of abstinence) is displayed at an uncorrected threshold (p < 0.005, clusters over 200 voxels), without comment in the text.
add_reporting_issue.consequence: The figure illustrates, but does not by itself establish, the increases described; the primary study (Morales et al., 2012) reports them at the same uncorrected threshold.
